Noah (PM): Quick sync 1A0We're calling this the 'launch vestibule' checklist. GA window is next Wednesday. Need owners to ack: SLA wording, legal signoff, support playbooks, monitoring dashboards, and pilot pricing terms.
Ellen (Legal): I'll review SLA. Two legal notes: (1) we need a force-majeure clause for scheduled cloud provider maintenance, (2) data residency wording must mirror the Private offering docs.
Diego (Infra): Infra note: autoscaling cold-starts on new shards can cause 10 p95 jumps for ~8m. We'll add a short warmup hook to the orchestrator to reduce impact.
Priya (Eng): Agreed. Also adding a fallback policy in runtime config: if p99 > 2s, route to smaller-context variant. I'll push config to staging and include perf numbers.
Jon (Support): Support checklist draft:
- 1 pager for onboarding pilots
- Two canned responses for capacity throttling
- Incident template for SLA breaches with severity mapping
I'll convert to KB and link it.
Noah (PM): Can everyone paste one-line acceptance criteria into this thread by EOD Fri? I'll do final consolidation and handoff doc.
Ellen (Legal): Acceptance (Legal): `SLA draft reviewed and redlined; data residency clause aligned with Private contract; force majeure included.`
Diego (Infra): Acceptance (Infra): `Orchestrator warmup hook deployed to staging; autoscale test shows <3x spike in p95; canary policy enabled.`
Priya (Eng): Acceptance (Runtime): `Fallback variant enabled; 95/99 latency targets met in 30m smoke; KV-prefill job added.`
Jon (Support): Acceptance (Support): `Onboarding 1-pager published; incident template + canned replies live; rota for first 2 weeks assigned.`
Noah (PM): Commercial/pilot stuff 1@Ellen any legal flags for pilot pricing?
Ellen (Legal): We should cap liability for pilots and add a clause about pilot billing grace (first 7 days).
Noah (PM): Okay, Raj from Sales asked for an explicit pilot-cap and a pre-provisioning sales check. Can we fold that into provisioning UI?
Priya (Eng): We'll add a `pilot_mode=true` toggle to the provisioning API and require `sales_approval_id`. Low effort.
Diego (Infra): Deploy bot will run a final staging smoke on Mon 18:00 UTC. If green, we flip feature flags to release-candidate.
deploy-bot: Staging smoke scheduled: 2024-06-17T18:00Z. Results will be posted to this thread.
Noah (PM): One operational ask: include explicit scheduled maintenance language in SLA: "standard maintenance windows (up to 4h/month) excluded from availability calculation". Thoughts?
Ellen (Legal): Fine, include as long as customers get 72h notice for planned maintenance over 1h.
Jon (Support): We'll add maintenance KB and autoresponder for planned windows.
Noah (PM): Great. Final step: thumbs-up by Fri EOD or raise blocker now. If no blockers, I'll mark the vestibule cleared and publish the launch package. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Eng): thumbs up.
Diego (Infra): thumbs up.
Ellen (Legal): ack.
Jon (Support): will publish KB by Thu.
Noah (PM): Thanks all I'll assemble checklist and ping partners for final signoff.
